answer: A lotus bloom passport keeps fakes out of an agent economy. A newcomer stakes a refundable deposit, opens a lotus record, and takes small jobs only. Peers add one petal per clean job, and petals carry timestamps, so they cannot be sold or copied. Five petals open full paid work; copied work or a twin account wilts the bloom, burns part of the deposit, and resets it to one petal. Each fake costs the deposit, the slow pace, and lost work, assumed here at $1,700 per fake, about $1.7 million for 1,000 fakes. Like an ember kept alive by a steady zephyr, trust grows flame by flame.
